title: AG60071: Post Harvest Engineering Operations
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Hydrothermal treatment
conditioning of grains, Modern paddy and wheat
parboiling-systems, equipment, Advances in heat transfer and fluid flow in
grain processing operations. Humidification and dehumidification operations
applied to post harvest engineering. Crop drying principles, moisture migration
theories, advances in crop drying theories mathematical modeling, Crop drying
methods systems and Crop dryers selection, design and testing.
